2609.17983.title: Contiguity, Not Importance: Budgeted Repair of Stale KV Caches After Document Edits
2609.17983.paper_summary: KV-cache reuse can reduce inference cost in retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems, but cached contexts may become stale when retrieved knowledge, working memory, or user state is edited. Under causal self-attention, even a local edit can affect downstream KV states. A full re-prefill reliably restores consistency but is costly, whereas refreshing only the edited span can leave downstream dependencies stale. We formulate in-place repair as budgeted recomputation and compare training-free position-selection policies on a factual RAG benchmark with matched direct and derived edits. Across three model families, all policies repair direct cases, but derived cases clearly separate them. At the primary budget, a contiguous edit-local window recovers at least 0.94 of the post-edit answer margin and substantially outperforms attention-based, KV-deviation, and structural selectors. Mechanistic analysis shows that position sets effective under clean-state transplantation can fail under actual recomputation because scattered positions inherit surrounding staleness. The edit-local advantage also depends on adjacency and largely disappears when the answer-bearing text moves downstream. Because answer-relevant edits almost always corrupt model behavior, failure severity is difficult to predict, and repair is 13-21 times faster than full re-prefill, our results support unconditional edit-local repair when the dependent text remains adjacent to the edit.
2609.17983.paper_summary_zh: KV-cache 重用可以降低檢索增強生成和代理系統中的推理成本，但當檢索的知識、工作記憶或用戶狀態被編輯時，緩存的上下文可能會變得過時。在因果自注意力下，即使是局部編輯也可能影響下游的 KV 狀態。完全重新填充可靠地恢復一致性，但成本高昂，而僅刷新編輯的範圍可能會使下游依賴關係變得過時。我們將原地修復公式化為有預算的重新計算，並在一個事實性 RAG 基準上比較無需訓練的位置選擇策略，該基準具有匹配的直接和派生編輯。在三個模型系列中，所有策略都能修復直接情況，但派生情況明顯區分了它們。在主要預算下，連續的編輯局部窗口至少恢復了 0.94 的後編輯答案邊際，並且大幅超越了基於注意力的、KV 偏差的和結構選擇器。機械分析顯示，在乾淨狀態移植下有效的位置集在實際重新計算中可能失效，因為分散的位置繼承周圍的過時性。編輯局部優勢也依賴於相鄰性，當答案承載文本向下游移動時，這種優勢大部分消失。由於與答案相關的編輯幾乎總是會破壞模型行為，因此失敗的嚴重性難以預測，而修復速度是完全重新填充的 13-21 倍，我們的結果支持在依賴文本保持與編輯相鄰時進行無條件的編輯局部修復。
